name: Hire and Develop Exceptional Talent
definition: Raise the level of the team with every hire, and share what you know through mentorship.

rows.situation: When the team is short and the pipeline is thin
rows.under: Hires someone adequate, to stop the pain.
rows.justRight: Holds the bar and manages the gap another way. A wrong hire is more expensive than an open role.
rows.over: Leaves the role open so long that the standard drops from exhaustion instead.

rows.situation: When the candidate thinks the way you do
rows.under: Reads familiarity as quality, and hires your own reflection.
rows.justRight: Hires for what the team is missing, and treats the discomfort of difference as the point.
rows.over: Hires for difference alone, and builds a team that cannot agree on anything.

rows.situation: When you are the only one who knows how it works
rows.under: Keeps it. Being needed feels like being valuable.
rows.justRight: Writes it down and teaches it until someone else can do it without you.
rows.over: Documents and teaches so much that you stop producing anything yourself.

rows.situation: When someone junior asks for the answer
rows.under: Gives the answer. It is faster, and they learn nothing.
rows.justRight: Gives enough that they can find it, and checks in before they are lost.
rows.over: Withholds the answer on principle while a deadline burns.

rows.situation: When your best person is ready for a bigger role elsewhere in the company
rows.under: Blocks the move, because your team needs them.
rows.justRight: Backs the move, and starts building the replacement now.
rows.over: Pushes people upward before they are ready, and sets them up to fail.
